analyst_view.overall: Early view: Sarri's Atalanta ended a month without a win by beating Monza 1-0, but one report says that only bought him time, and his injury list is long (Gaetano, Bellanova, Kristensen, Hien, Raspadori and Kossounou). Chivu's Inter won 2-0 against Como, but Lautaro has been out with a muscle injury since 15 October and Bonny was hurt against Como, so Thuram and Pio Esposito carry the attack. Inter host Stuttgart in the Champions League three days later, and Atalanta go to Borac Banja Luka in the Conference League.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. I lean slightly lower: Inter's striker cover is thin with Lautaro and Bonny injured, and Atalanta lost 3-0 at home to Parma before scraping a 1-0 at Monza. Atalanta's home games still average 3.6 goals, so the lean is small.

corners.text: The site expects 9.6 corners. I lean slightly higher: Atalanta's home games have averaged about ten and Inter's away games just over ten. Inter's wide players Dimarco and Spence attack the flanks, and that produces corners.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.1 cards. I lean higher: this is a big game for an Atalanta side under pressure, and Inter's away games have averaged over four cards. Atalanta's home games have been unusually calm, so the referee will matter here.

shots.text: The site expects 28.8 shots. I lean higher because Atalanta's home games have averaged about 33 shots and Inter's away games about 31. Both teams shoot often, and Atalanta at home go forward even against the leaders.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. I lean slightly higher, since Atalanta's home games have produced about 12 on target and Inter away about nine. Carnesecchi was busy at Monza, and Inter's counters through Thuram usually end with a shot on target.
